column1: 21. ASSETS CLASSIFIED AS HELD FOR SALE

Property, plant and equipment
Prepaid operating leases

The company intends to dispose off 13 stations and other facilities in the next 12 months. These were previously used for the
company’s operations. Buyers have already been identified and sale and purchase agreements dated 30 August 2010 were
signed between the company and the buyers.
No impairment loss was recognized on reclassification of the assets from property, plant and equipment and prepaid operating
leases to assets classified as held for sale as at 31 December 2010 as the expected proceeds on disposal exceed the net
carrying amounts of the assets.
